summary: Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K under Items 5.08 and 8.01 announcing an extraordinary general meeting in lieu of an annual general meeting, to be held at Ellenoff Grossman Schole LLP in New York, with the exact date and time to be set in a forthcoming definitive proxy statement. Shareholder proposals must be delivered to the Boston office by October 8, 2026, and only proxy-noticed business may be transacted. The meeting partly satisfies Nasdaq Listing Rule 5620(a); Class I director terms do not expire because the EGM is not a Cayman annual general meeting. No deal terms or special situation.
